Name: (CP) Coffee Roaster
Author: HarrisonGrey
Description:
[center]Love the speed buff of coffee but wish it could be a little more efficiently made? End up with a bulk of coffee beans and tea leaves after only a couple seasons? Well then the [b]Coffee Roaster[/b] might just be for you![/center]

This mod adds a new [b]Coffee Roaster[/b], a craftable machine which can be made using:
﻿[b]10 Hardwood
[/b] [b]﻿3 Iron Bar
[/b] [b]﻿1 Solar Essence[/b]

﻿The crafting recipe can be purchased at the Saloon for 10,000g, putting the machine in a similar category as the Dehydrator and Fish Smoker. Similarly at the Saloon, on Fridays you'll be able to purchase 1 seasonal Coffee; the description lets you know what flavoring item makes this coffee.

﻿The Coffee Roaster produces the [b]Coffee Blend[/b], a bag of coffee grounds made from placing 1 flavoring item into the Roaster with 20 Coffee Beans as fuel. There is one flavor per season, the flavor item being a foraging item from that season; Salmonberry makes the Morning Berry Blend, Spice Berry makes the Calico Roast Blend, Hazelnut makes the Autumn Afternoon Blend, and Crystal Fruit makes the Snowcap Lodge Blend. Using a Pumpkin as the flavor item gives you the Pumpkin Spice Blend, though by default it's only available for a limited time and can only be made with the Roaster during Fall. Tree Fruit can be used to make the Orchard Espresso Blend.

﻿The Coffee Blend can be placed in the Keg or the Coffee Maker to make a whole pot of coffee; in the Keg, you'll receive between 1-2 [b]Flavored[/b] [b]Coffee[/b], while the Coffee Maker is more effective, making between 2-3. Your coffees made in the Keg are ready in 120 minutes. Coffees made in the Coffee Maker will not be ready until the following morning, replacing that morning's coffee; if you do not add another Coffee Blend to the Coffee Maker, it will make a regular cup of coffee the following morning like usual. The Pumpkin Spice Blend makes [b]Pumpkin Spice Lattes[/b] which can be made year round, even if the Blend itself can only be made seasonally. The Orchard Espresso Blend makes [b]Opulent Orchard Espresso[/b], a renamed version of the vanilla Triple Shot Espresso.

﻿Not a coffee person? This mod also adds [b]Matcha Powder[/b], made by placing 20 Tea Leaves into the Dehydrator. Matcha Powder can similarly be placed in the Keg or Coffee Maker to make [b]Boba Tea/Green Tea Lattes[/b].

﻿All flavors of the Coffee Blend are actually one item with different colors, meaning only one needs to be shipped to complete the Shipping Collection. The Matcha Powder can also be shipped. The Flavored Coffee and Green Tea Latte are excluded from the Shipping Collection.

﻿NPC Gift Tastes are also updated to include the new items, including some new dialogue responses from select characters. Most of the coffees are Universal Likes, but Pumpkin Spice Lattes is a neutral gift in general and can result in strong opinions from specific characters.

[b]Buffs[/b]
﻿Obviously the main benefit of the Coffee Roaster blends is a longer speed boost, lasting the same amount of time as the Triple Shot Espresso in the vanilla game, but each flavor adds a unique buff of their own; Morning Berry Blend grants a +2 Foraging buff; Calico Roast grants a +3 Attack buff; Autumn Afternoon grants +2 Defense and +2 Immunity; Snowcap Lodge grants +2 Mining and +25 Magnetic Radius; Pumpkin Spice Latte grants +2 Luck. The Green Tea Latte only gives +0.5 speed boost but it lasts the remainder of the day (or until replaced by another drink buff). The Opulent Orchard Espresso is actually the same item as the Triple Shot Espresso, and gives only the speed buff.

This mod adds a unique buff icon to cover all the buffs granted by coffee drinks to prevent your screen from being cluttered by buff icons.﻿

[b]Seasonal Sprites
[/b] ﻿Surprised to see your farmer guzzling a piping hot cup of coffee on a sizzling summer day? All the drinks in this mod have seasonal changes; by default, in Spring and Summer your drinks are served cold, Iced Coffees and Boba Tea. In Fall and Winter, your drinks are nice and hot and in convenient to-go cups. Sprites, names, and descriptions reflect these changes.

[b]Config Options[/b]
﻿"[i]Coffee Sprites[/i]": If you prefer either the hot drinks or the cold drinks, this will let you configure the mod to display only one or the other. Default is Seasonal.
﻿"[i]Seasonal Pumpkin Spice[/i]": By default the Pumpkin Spice Blend can only be made in Fall and Winter, but this can be configured to allow the Coffee Roaster to make it year round.
﻿"[i]Include Matcha Items[/i]": Allows you to not load the Matcha Powder and Green Tea Latte if another mod adds those or similar items (or you just want to stick to the coffee).

[b]Compatibilities[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]﻿Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url]: The Coffee Blends of this mod can be placed in Atelier's Coffee Brewer to make Latte versions of all the coffee drinks (Matcha not included). Like Atelier's Lattes, this will require Atelier's Cream as a fuel item, but the result will be Gold Quality, meaning non-speed buffs are further boosted.

[b]Translate Me![/b]
This mod is translation ready, feel free to post your own translation if you'd like as long as you don't use ai to do so.
